reuse.why: Builds on the existing month-fill module (getMonthFillCategories, isMonthFillCategory, toAverageFillAmount), reuses extractTagsFromText for #fixed, and the new action reuses getSheetValue, batchMessages and the mutator(undoable()) registration.

duplication.why: The lock rule exists once in isLockedForMonthFill, but the notes/goal_def join is written twice (getMonthFillCategories and getBudgetData) and includeHiddenCategories plumbing is repeated in every action signature.

placement.why: The selection/lock rule lives in month-fill.ts, the action in actions.ts and the handler registration in app.ts, matching the existing layering.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; the old isHiddenForMonthCopy is replaced rather than left behind.

maintainability.why: One isLockedForMonthFill predicate covers hidden, template and #fixed rules for both the category list and copy-previous-month, though the copy path still applies it separately on its own row shape.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action takes its categories from getMonthFillCategories or isLockedForMonthFill.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated notes/goal_def join in getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories is a visible, small repetition, not a disguised copy.

abstraction_drift.where: isLockedForMonthFill gains the includeHiddenCategories parameter (getMonthFillCategories already had an equivalent hidden flag); no special-case branches and no actions that bypass the shared selection.
